findings.issue: H8318 הַשֶּׁרֶץ is a definite singular swarming/teeming creature; «reptil» narrows it to the animal class reptile and drops the swarming sense.
בְּ is only marked as a preposition; «en» locks a locative reading where the phrase is the means of defilement.
הָרֹמֵשׂ is a definite qal participle modifying the same שֶׁרֶץ; «el reptil el reptante» can be read as two nouns rather than one creeping creature.

notes: Ustedes futures and «sus» keep the 2pl address; verbless «yo Jehová» and «santo yo» add no unmarked copula.
